evidenceStrengthLegend.direct: Original assertion/stack or actual API status; demonstrates the observed symptom, not necessarily cause.

evidenceStrengthLegend.reviewed: Archived source/independent review explains the mechanism within its stated scope.
evidenceStrengthLegend.unknown: No definitive causal trace; non-recurrence and mitigation are not proof.
